meta.status: seeded_unverified: transcribed from the PDF text; no primary source read
meta.pdf_defaults_status: PENDING OWNER (Law cl.6): no default view of a conflicting source has been chosen here
meta.time_convention: naive ISO-8601 local mean time as printed (Union and Confederate clocks differed by about 20 minutes; no correction applied)
meta.tier_rule: tier = printed PDF tier AND >=1 cited key outside the weak set; weak set = Wikipedia (Wiki-*, W-CONS), forums (CWT*), blogs the PDF flags (WHB*, GC-COMP), Stone Sentinels (SS-*, SStone-*). Mechanical only: no source opened to confirm it supports the exact claim.
meta.window_semantics: time.window = [earliest, latest, default]. granularity "clock": at least one bound is a printed clock time. granularity "date": bounds are the start (00:00) and 23:59 of the printed date(s); the position inside the day is NOT known and state_at reports it as indeterminate. "default" is non-null only where the PDF prints a single time for the transition. earliest null = not printed ("by X"); state_at then places the change at the latest bound and flags it.
meta.scenarios: Scenario "default" = the row as the engine reads it in B.8.7 (not a choice between conflicting sources). Named scenarios expose the PDF alternatives.
